name: Water Caustics
desc: A luminous rippling net of light filaments dances across the whole frame like sunlight focused on a pool floor, bright cyan-white caustics interweaving over teal-indigo depths and endlessly flowing; renders as bright pool, bioluminescent deep-sea, golden sunlit sand, thermal false-color, or a named grayscale.

density.doc: fullness of the caustic net (more overlapping ripples)
